examples.title: Audit Compute Unit usage and active sessions
examples.input_or_trigger: /colab-pilot:colab-pilot Check active Colab sessions and Compute Unit burn.
prerequisites: Install Colab Pilot and authenticate the colab command-line tool.
examples.expected_behavior: Inspect live Compute Unit balance, burn rate, and active assignments without allocating a new VM.

examples.title: Run zero-waste GPU training on Colab
examples.input_or_trigger: $colab-train Stage my dataset archive to Drive and launch training on an A100 or L4.
prerequisites: Validate local archives and configure rclone for Google Drive staging.
examples.expected_behavior: Stage archives to Google Drive at zero Compute Unit cost, allocate a BF16 GPU cascade, launch detached training, and stop the VM after pulling outputs.

examples.title: Fan out CPU extraction across parallel shards
examples.input_or_trigger: /colab-pilot:colab-shard-cpu Run extraction across 5 CPU-only Colab workers.
prerequisites: Provide a shard-aware Python script that reads SHARD_INDEX and SHARD_TOTAL.
examples.expected_behavior: Provision isolated CPU-only Colab VMs, run each shard concurrently, merge the resulting archives, and stop every worker VM.

examples.title: Monitor a detached job with the watchdog
examples.input_or_trigger: $colab-watch Watch my detached Colab job and trigger the wakeup alarm on completion.
prerequisites: Launch a detached job with colab_launch_detached.
examples.expected_behavior: Poll remote job status and logs until completion, error, or stall, then print Compute Unit usage.

examples.title: Connect the pilot MCP server
examples.input_or_trigger: Open the Colab Pilot dashboard and inspect active sessions.
prerequisites: Install Colab Pilot with Python 3.9 or later and the colab command-line tool.
examples.expected_behavior: Start the local stdio pilot MCP server and expose all 10 Colab orchestration tools.

examples.title: Open the Colab Pilot dashboard
examples.input_or_trigger: Show my Colab Compute Unit balance and one-fifth monthly budget status.
examples.expected_behavior: Return live Compute Unit balance, burn rate, active sessions, detached jobs, and alarm state.

examples.title: Allocate a BF16 GPU cascade
examples.input_or_trigger: Allocate a BF16 GPU session named train-v10 trying A100-highmem, A100, G4, and L4.
prerequisites: Ensure Colab account has GPU quota.
examples.expected_behavior: Try each GPU tier in order, probe VRAM and system RAM, verify BF16 support, and return safe DataLoader sizing.

examples.title: Mount Google Drive headlessly with rclone
examples.input_or_trigger: Mount Google Drive on session train-v10 in streaming mode.
prerequisites: Configure a local rclone.conf file for Google Drive.
examples.expected_behavior: Copy rclone configuration to the Colab VM and mount Drive read-only without interactive OAuth 2.0 prompts.

examples.title: Transfer large archives safely
examples.input_or_trigger: Pre-stage dataset.tar to Google Drive at zero Compute Unit cost.
examples.expected_behavior: Route files up to 24 MiB directly and larger files through Drive staging or verified 24 MiB chunks.

examples.title: Launch a detached training job
examples.input_or_trigger: Launch train.py detached on session train-v10.
examples.expected_behavior: Start the script under nohup with log normalization and 10-second GPU heartbeat status JSON.

examples.title: Poll detached job status
examples.input_or_trigger: Poll job job-1234 on session train-v10.
examples.expected_behavior: Download status JSON and recent log lines via REST without holding a WebSocket open.

examples.title: Flush zombie VRAM after an OOM
examples.input_or_trigger: Reset zombie VRAM on session train-v10.
prerequisites: Have an active GPU Colab session.
examples.expected_behavior: Clear traceback references, IPython caches, and PyTorch CUDA cache, then report before and after VRAM.

examples.title: Register a keep-warm lease
examples.input_or_trigger: Keep session train-v10 warm for 30 minutes.
examples.expected_behavior: Record a timed lease so the Stop guardrail allows ending the turn without stopping the VM.

examples.title: Stop all active Colab VMs
examples.input_or_trigger: Stop all active Colab sessions and verify zero burn rate.
examples.expected_behavior: Stop every active Colab session, clear leases, and confirm zero active assignments.

examples.title: Run wakeup alarm self-test
examples.input_or_trigger: Run a self-test on the Colab Pilot wakeup alarm.
prerequisites: Use macOS for live speech playback or any host for WAV self-test.
examples.expected_behavior: Verify voice rotation and accelerating chirp synthesis without playing audio.

examples.title: Report active Colab sessions at startup
examples.input_or_trigger: Start a new session while a Colab VM is allocated.
examples.expected_behavior: Inject a concise system message listing active sessions and current Compute Unit burn rate.

examples.title: Block TTY-hanging or unsafe colab command-line calls
examples.input_or_trigger: Attempt to run colab drivemount or a 50 MiB direct colab upload.
examples.expected_behavior: Deny the command before execution and direct the agent to colab_mount_rclone or colab_smart_transfer.

examples.title: Prevent orphaned Compute Unit burn on turn end
examples.input_or_trigger: Finish a turn while an unleased Colab VM is still running.
examples.expected_behavior: Block stopping and instruct the agent to call colab_stop_all or colab_keep_warm.

antigravity.notes: Install with agy plugin install https://github.com/swack-tools/colab-pilot-plugin and invoke /colab-pilot, /colab-train, /colab-shard-cpu, or /colab-watch.

claude-code.notes: Install from swack-tools/ai-plugin-marketplace and invoke /colab-pilot:colab-pilot or ask Claude to orchestrate Colab.

slack.notes: The repository does not document a Slack integration.

pilot.description: Local stdio MCP server providing 10 Colab orchestration tools and an interactive dashboard.

hooks.description: Report active Colab sessions and Compute Unit burn rate when a session starts.
Block interactive TTY colab commands, invalid GPU tiers, and direct uploads larger than 30 MiB.
Block ending a turn while an unleased Colab VM remains allocated with no running detached job.
